name: Azure API Management
summary: Azure API Management is Microsoft's hosted API gateway and management platform. It checks API keys and tokens, enforces quotas and rate limits, and includes a developer portal and usage analytics. Microsoft publishes no price: its pricing page lists each tier with a billing unit and no amount, so every plan here is shown as quote only.

facts.text: The key concepts page says the API gateway receives client requests and forwards them to backend services, acting as a facade to those services.
The key concepts page says the gateway verifies API keys and other credentials such as JWTs and certificates, and enforces usage quotas and rate limits.
The key concepts page describes an open-source developer portal where API consumers read documentation, subscribe to get API keys and access analytics on their own usage.
The key concepts page says the tiers are Classic (Developer, Basic, Standard and Premium), V2 (Basic v2, Standard v2 and Premium v2) and Consumption.
According to the pricing page, prices are calculated in US dollars, but no amount on the page is filled in. Isolated is marked TBA, and the AI Gateway tier says pricing is coming soon.
